title: Safety gate tuning, shadow feedback-loop, and rollback heuristics
creator: Evelyn Chen
description: Follow-up work from the failed staged-model deployment on 2025-11-04. The incident surfaced two gaps: 1) a slow feedback loop between shadow telemetry and canary gating decisions (metrics lag and signal dilution), and 2) insufficient rollback heuristics that treated all error classes equally, causing brittle automated rollbacks during transient downstream failures. This ticket captures proposed mitigations: tighten safety gate definitions, add a continuous shadow-to-canary feedback pipeline that surfaces actionable deltas within 5 minutes, and implement a multi-dimensional rollback heuristic that weights error class, traffic fraction, and synthetic test regressions before triggering automated rollback. Deliverables: updated runbook snippets, metric SLO adjustments, implementation RFC for rollback heuristics, and 2 sub-tasks to add synthetic canary checks and shadow-derived alerts.
comments: 2025-11-08 - Evelyn Chen: Created ticket after incident retro. Attached initial metrics snapshots and timeline from the failed rollout. Noted that latency regressions were concentrated on tail P99 for sequences >1024, and hallucination rate increased in live queries for a single customer integration.

2025-11-09 - Marco Hernández: Initial triage done. Confirmed shadow traffic lacked a fast path for aggregating per-model deltas. Proposed a lightweight streaming job to compute rolling deltas and feed a decision service. Drafting RFC for rollback heuristic design — will propose soft-rollback (traffic reduction) before full rollback for noisy signals.

2025-11-10 - Priya Nair (PM): Reviewed and suggested adding customer-facing escalation steps and clarifying which customers get notified during partial rollbacks. Ask: include thresholds that suppress noisy alerts during infra blips.
2025-11-10 - Design review (Aisha Patel): UX for Console notification banners and an explainer for partial traffic reductions approved with minor text changes. Will provide copy for runbook messages.

2025-11-11 - Marco Hernández: Implemented prototype of shadow-to-canary aggregator. End-to-end tests show 4–6 minute delta detection on dev traffic. Pushed branch: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4123. Awaiting infra review.

2025-11-12 - SRE (Jordan Lee): Flagged potential cost impact of running continuous shadow aggregations at full QPS; suggested sampling and prioritized traces for high-risk customers. Marked blocker for autodeploy until sampling is implemented.
2025-11-12 - Evelyn Chen: Updated runbook to include a 'soft-rollback' step and added escalation matrix. Scheduling a review with legal for customer notification wording next week.

runbook_changes: Add pre-canary checklist: verify synthetic canary baseline within last 10 minutes and pipeline health OK
Introduce 'soft-rollback' action: reduce canary traffic by 50% and monitor for 10 minutes before full rollback
Define error classes and weightings: infrastructure 0.3, model-drift/hallucination 0.6, latency tail 0.4; aggregate to threshold >0.5 to trigger auto actions
Add explicit suppression rules for transient infra blips (3-minute grace window) to avoid noisy rollbacks
Append clear tracer links and dashboard shortcuts for on-call to inspect model version deltas and per-customer error rates
decision_log: 2025-11-09: Chose streaming shadow aggregation over batch because we need sub-10-minute deltas for gating decisions
2025-11-10: Agreed on soft-rollback as default first action to reduce blast radius during ambiguous signals
2025-11-11: Decided to use sampled shadow traffic to control cost; high-risk customers get full fidelity by default
2025-11-12: Require synthetic canary checks as part of pre-canary gate in runtime-1.19
